If you had to choose between starting a family or curing cancer, which would you choose?

I'd cure cancer. Starting a family isn't really that important to me (not to say I don't want a family), and cancer affects millions of people all over the world. Even if it's not fatal, it still lowers the overall quality of life for the person.

Also, I don't think that overpopulation is that much of a problem. I remember reading somewhere that the Earth could easily sustain 11 billion people before things started to get really rough, and if we changed some of out habits around, maybe even more.
I think the 7B on this planet is already pushing the ecosystem out of balance. I'd love to see humans change their habits, but I'm not optimistic.
Gotta be curing cancer. I'd feel like a jackass if I chose my own happiness over saving millions of lives.

Curing cancer. I might be able to live without a family. Or not, and I'd end myself. But at least I die knowing I did the right thing for humanity, in contrast to so many other players on this planet.
I'd cure cancer and make the treatment free.
Curing cancer. I don't want a family, and it would be selfish of me not to.

Curing cancer; you can't mourn something you've never had and I've never started a family before.

That said, between starting a family for sure and trying to cure cancer, I'd take the safe bet of doing something I want to do some day (start a family) over the hypothetical. Selfish? Sure, but that's how it is.

To that end that there are things I would definitely pick over curing cancer out of selfishness. Wouldn't give up 20 years of my lifespan if that was what it took to cure cancer for everyone, for example.
